title: Projects
intro: Explore our ongoing and completed projects.

items.title: Project 01: Urban Mobility
items.summary: Investigating sustainable public transport networks and smart traffic management solutions for modern metropolitan areas.

items.title: Project 02: Renewable Energy
items.summary: Analysing the efficiency and grid integration of decentralized photovoltaic systems in rural communities.

items.title: Project 03: Digital Archives
items.summary: Developing open-access digital repositories for the preservation and study of historical manuscripts and artefacts.

items.title: Project 04: Environmental Health
items.summary: Monitoring air quality indices and assessing respiratory health impacts across industrial and residential zones.

items.title: Project 05: Inclusive Education
items.summary: Designing collaborative digital learning tools to support accessibility and engagement for students with special needs.

items.title: Project 06: Circular Economy
items.summary: Evaluating lifecycle reduction strategies and waste-to-resource material flows in regional manufacturing sectors.

items.title: Project 07: Coastal Resilience
items.summary: Modelling wave action dynamics and testing nature-based solutions to mitigate shoreline erosion risks.

items.title: Project 08: Smart Agriculture
items.summary: Deploying IoT sensor networks for precision soil moisture tracking and optimised crop irrigation management.
